gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 3; Recurrent Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 4; Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Given autologous TGF-betaR2KO/IL13R-alpha2-CAR T cells intracranially

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed disease: radiographic evidence of recurrence/progression of measurable disease after standard therapy

role_evidence.quote: Given autologous TGF-betaR2KO/IL13R-alpha2-CAR T cells intracranially

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous IL13Ralpha2-targeting CAR T cells with TGFbetaR2 knockout

source_quote.quote: COH clinical pathology confirms IL13Rα2+ tumor expression by immunohistochemistry (H-score ≥ 80)
Participant has a prior histologically-confirmed diagnosis of a grade 3 or 4 IDH-mutant astrocytoma or glioblastoma

coder_notes: Only intervention of interest is CAR T-cell therapy (excluded type), so no candidate. IL13Ralpha2 is the CAR target but the CAR product is not a candidate, so candidate_matched is false. CAR T persistence (CSF, tumour microenvironment) and IL13Ralpha2 expression change pre/post are exploratory objectives for a cell therapy, not for a candidate drug, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned are coded no (adjudicator may wish to treat these as yes if cell-therapy measurements are meant to count). Population includes IDH-mutant grade 3/4 astrocytoma and recurrent glioblastoma.
